title: Human Resources Business Partner
description:
Quem somos nós


A Keeta é a subsidiária internacional da Meituan, gigante global no setor de entregas, e está em uma missão ambiciosa: revolucionar a entrega de alimentos e produtos de consumo em todo o mundo. Nosso lema é simples e poderoso: “Ajudamos as pessoas a comer melhor, viver melhor.” É com base nele que levamos inovação e tecnologia para o cenário global.

Com mais de 1.000 colaboradores no mundo, a Keeta está em plena expansão — e você pode fazer parte dessa jornada!


Suas responsabilidades

  • Atuar como um parceiro estratégico de RH, apoiando os esforços de aquisição de talentos e construindo mecanismos de longo prazo para o desenvolvimento e retenção de colaboradores.
  • Servir como elo entre as áreas de negócio e o RH, garantindo sintonia e colaboração para o alcance dos resultados organizacionais.
  • Prestar consultoria interna a líderes e equipes, oferecendo soluções ágeis, simplificadas e adaptadas às demandas locais.
  • Conduzir e supervisionar todo o ciclo de vida do colaborador, desde a entrada até o desligamento, promovendo experiências consistentes e positivas.
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com a equipe de Talent Acquisition para alinhar estratégias de atração e seleção de acordo com as prioridades do negócio.
  • Monitorar e apoiar a gestão de desempenho e do clima organizacional, fornecendo análises e dados que fortaleçam a tomada de decisão dos líderes.
  • Identificar necessidades de desenvolvimento, apoiando líderes na criação e execução de projetos e iniciativas de treinamento.
  • Garantir a conformidade com políticas internas, legislações locais e práticas de diversidade e inclusão.
  • Aplicar visão de negócios para propor melhorias de estrutura organizacional e eficiência operacional.
  • Liderar iniciativas culturais que aumentem o engajamento, a coesão das equipes e a construção de um ambiente de trabalho saudável e produtivo.
  • Atuar como ponte cultural e estratégica entre equipes locais e a liderança global, trazendo percepções críticas que apoiem o crescimento sustentável.


Requisitos

  • Graduação completa;
    mínimo de 5 anos de experiência em cargos de Recursos Humanos.
  • Experiência prévia como HRBP ou generalista em empresas de internet/tecnologia é altamente desejável.
  • Fluência em inglês é obrigatória.
  • Capacidade de analisar organizações, propor estruturas eficazes e liderar iniciativas de RH em cenários dinâmicos e de alta velocidade.
  • Forte senso de responsabilidade, acessibilidade e habilidade de construir relações de confiança em todos os níveis.
  • Modelo de trabalho: Presencial.


Diferenciais

  • Experiência em empresas na fase inicial de operação no Brasil (stage 0→1), especialmente em contextos de rápida expansão.
  • Vivência com empresas chinesas ou em ambientes multiculturais com estruturas e dinâmicas asiáticas.

Interessado(a) em fazer parte da Keeta?


Confira nossas vagas abertas! Ao se candidatar, suas informações serão armazenadas de forma segura e poderão ser compartilhadas com a Keeta e suas empresas afiliadas ao redor do mundo.

  • Experiência comprovada em auditorias de sistemas ERP , especialmente SAP (módulos FI, MM, SD, GRC).

title: Senior Backend Engineer (Req English)
description:
3thix
Remote-First (Global) | Full-Time
About 3thix
3thix is a next-generation fintech platform bridging traditional payments with blockchain rails. We power seamless, low-cost, and compliant transfers using stable tokens, smart contracts, and hybrid on/off-ramp infrastructure. Backed by top-tier VCs, we process millions in daily volume and are expanding into new corridors and asset classes.
The Role
We’re hiring a Senior Backend Engineer with deep expertise in fintech payment systems, blockchain protocols, and stable token ecosystems (USDC, USDT, EURC, etc.). You’ll design, build, and scale the core transaction engine that routes fiat ↔ crypto, settles on-chain, and ensures regulatory compliance at every step.
What You’ll Do
Architect and maintain high-throughput payment orchestration services handling fiat deposits, crypto swaps, stable token mint/burn, and instant settlements.
Build reconciliation systems that sync on-chain events (EVM, Solana, Stellar) with off-chain ledgers and banking rails (ACH, SEPA, SWIFT, SPEI).
Implement risk, fraud, and AML controls in real-time transaction pipelines.
Design idempotent, event-driven microservices using Kafka / Pulsar and domain-driven patterns.
Own blockchain node infrastructure (Geth, Solana RPC, custom indexers) and write secure smart-contract interaction layers.
Scale systems to 10k+ TPS with sub-100ms latency for cross-border flows.
Collaborate with compliance and product teams to embed KYC/KYT, travel-rule data, and sanction screening.
Lead incident response for payment disputes, rollbacks, and chain re-orgs.
Must-Have Skills
5+ years backend engineering in high-scale environments.
Production experience in fintech / payments (acquiring, issuing, remittance, or payout systems).
Deep blockchain knowledge:
EVM-compatible chains (Ethereum, Polygon, Arbitrum)
Stable token standards (ERC-20, SPL, CCTP)
MEV, gas optimization, and on-chain data indexing (The Graph, Dune, custom subsql)
Mastery of Go, Rust, or TypeScript/Node.Js (we primarily use Go).
Event sourcing, CQRS, and distributed transaction patterns.
Secure handling of HSMs, key management (KMS, MPC), and cryptographic signing.
Observability stack: Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, ELK.
Experience with regulated environments (PCI-DSS, SOC2, PSD2, FinCEN travel rule).
Nice-to-Have
Built or audited stablecoin issuance/redemption systems.
Contributed to open-source blockchain tooling or payment protocols.
Worked with layer-2 networks (Optimism, Base, zkSync) or cross-chain bridges.
Familiarity with ISO 20022, FedNow, or RTP rails.
Tech Stack
Core: Go, Rust, PostgreSQL, Redis, Kafka
Blockchain: Solidity, Hardhat, Foundry, ethers.Js, viem, Solana SDK
Infra: Kubernetes, Terraform, GCP/AWS, Grafana Tempo
Security: HashiCorp Vault, AWS KMS, Fireblocks MPC
Why Join 3thix
Equity in a rocket-ship startup.
Unlimited PTO + global off-sites.
Top-tier health, dental, and remote workspace stipend.
Work directly with ex-Stripe, Circle, and Coinbase engineers.
Shape the future of programmable money.

title: Sr Product Owner
description:
At Dover Fueling Solutions (DFS), we are taking fueling and convenience retail to the next level. We are passionate about cultivating excellence in everything we do, but what really fuels us is our people. They’re the heart of our company. As an employee, our promise to you is that you’ll work on new and innovative products and solutions, be mentored by managers and teammates who are collaborative, caring, and act with integrity, and have the opportunity to grow in ways that are meaningful to you. Unique and interesting projects – both locally and globally – will challenge you and allow you to pursue different and rewarding career paths.


We are #EnergizedByGrowth.


DFS is part of a legacy of leadership that spans back generations, made up of some of the most trusted, leading-edge brands in the industry. As part of Dover Corporation and with our talented, innovative, outstanding people, we are doing great things and redefining what is possible in fueling and convenience retail. Providing advanced fuel-dispensing equipment, including clean energy solutions, systems and payment, automatic tank gauging and wet stock-management solutions, DFS comprises the product brands of Wayne Fueling Systems, OPW Fuel Management Systems, ClearView, Tokheim, ProGauge, Fairbanks, LIQAL, AvaLAN, and Bulloch Technologies. Headquartered in Austin, TX, DFS has a significant technology development and manufacturing presence worldwide, including facilities in Brazil, China, India, Italy, Poland, the Netherlands, the United Kingdom and the United Stat.


Summary

Responsible for software development projects for payment terminals and embedded media for Latin America.


Detailed Description Of The Activities

  • Rapid understanding and development of new functions in the payment software platform, DFS embedded media products.
  • Represent stakeholders during the project and monitor projects with customers (internal and/or external).
  • Organize and plan the product backlog, conducting meetings with stakeholders to prioritize the items to be developed whenever necessary.
  • Responsible for the decisions of which teamwork will maximize the value of the product and add more to those involved, sets goals, prioritizes and approves quality, always seeking to ensure the highest return on investment.
  • Maintain the agile management principles followed by the team, supporting the Scrum processes with the team (daily, planning, review and retrospective), Kanban and other applicable methods.
  • Assist the commercial teams in the presentation of existing or new products, understanding of new demands and support in the generation of commercial proposals for specific new projects or improvements in existing projects, and should support the other areas of the company in the preparation of equipment and specific versions for demonstrations, fairs and presentations.
  • Prepare reports so that everyone is aligned on the status of developments, according to the processes and frameworks used by DFS for project management and new product development.
  • Coordinate SW releases to the field and provide support afterwards.
  • Train internal and external support teams, as well as DFS manufacturing areas in new products or versions that generate significant changes.
  • Create, maintain and disseminate the KPIs of the area.
  • Promote innovation, review and continuous improvement of the team's processes seeking process improvements, reduction of operating costs and maintenance of systems.
  • Document and assist in the implementation of processes that support the manufacturing, testing and quality control process of the equipment that involves our software/hardware solutions.
  • Monitor and support internal and external audit processes (ISO).
  • Support customers of projects involving our payment platform in certification processes with card brands and networks, including PCI, EMV, etc.
  • Perform other related tasks, at the discretion of the immediate superior.


Instruction

Complete higher education in Computer Engineering or related areas.


Specific Knowledge

  • Advanced/fluent English and Spanish;
  • Programming language: C# and XML;
  • Knowledge of cryptography;
  • Device connection (TCP, Serial, etc);
  • Knowledge of network (wired, wireless, routers, etc.);
  • Domain in Agile/Scrum methodologies.


Desirable

  • Development and integrations of payment methods -
  • Jira;
  • TeamCity;
  • GITHub;
  • Confluence;
  • Support customers of projects involving our payment platform in certification processes with card brands and networks, including PCI, EMV, etc;
    .
  • Perform other related tasks, at the discretion of the immediate superior.


We consider several job-related, non-discriminatory factors when determining the pay rate for a position, including, but not limited to, the position’s responsibilities, a candidate’s work experience, a candidate’s education/training, the position’s location, and the key skills needed for the position. Pay is one of the Total Rewards that we provide to compensate and recognize employees for their work.

title: Hr Operation Senior Specialist
description:
【Responsibilities】

Develop, implement, and maintain comprehensive HR operations policies and SOPs that align with business goals and compliance requirements.

Ensure HR policies are consistently applied across all business units.

Regularly review work with relevant department and update HR policies to reflect changes in employment laws and best practices.

- Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field;
Master’s degree is a plus.

- Strong knowledge of HR policy frameworks, compliance, and global employment regulations.

- Experience in developing and implementing HR SOPs and process documentation.

- Proficiency in HR technology solutions and data-driven decision-making.

- Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.


【Highlights】

- Be a driver in creating HR policies in a rapidly growing global company.

- Influence decision-making by implementing scalable HR frameworks that will define future operations.

- Work with cross-functional teams across multiple geographies to develop global HR policies while ensuring local compliance.

- Gain hands-on experience navigating the complexities of international HR operations in a fast-scaling business.

- Drive a culture of continuous improvement and quality audits to enhance HR service delivery.

title: Lead Technical Consultant
description:
Lead Talent Partner at Synamedia - We are Hiring! | Master's in European Studies and International Relations

Company Overview

At Synamedia, we’re a global team of 1,700+ trailblazers across 20 countries, revolutionizing how the world is entertained and informed. With a legacy of protecting our long-time customers, we’re laser-focused on driving growth and leading the charge as the industry shifts from Pay-TV to IP and streaming. We are the pioneers in next-gen media cloud services who power the viewing experiences of billions of people on Earth with our best-in-class live streaming, distribution, ad tech, cloud platforms, and more.

Our solutions, built over three decades and trusted by 1,000+ customers, fuel giants like Disney, NBA, The Olympics, Astro, Comcast, Tata Play, and many more.

Ready to grow with us and shape the future of media and entertainment solutions? Let’s do it together!

About the Job – Lead Technical Consultant

Key Responsibilities:

  • Ensuring a healthy platform delivering smooth services for all the customers.
  • Provide strong technical leadership to ensure continuous improvement across the team
  • Prime contributor for automation and scripting tasks.
  • Must have worked in a fast-paced, quick response/crisis handling team.
  • In-depth knowledge and experience of supporting complex projects.
  • Command and control during High Priority Events.
  • Responsible for contribution in refining Service Centre tools and processes.
  • Implement monitoring scripts to prevent repetitive issues.
  • Able to work independently or as part of a team towards complex issue resolutions.
  • Ability to collaborate with customer deployment teams.
  • Solid communicator, with excellent written and spoken Portuguese and English.
  • Must know ITIL framework (Incident, Change, Problem, configuration)
  • Independently/collectively troubleshoot issues reported by customer on ServiceNow ticketing tool.
  • Accurate analysis, tracking and reporting of any problems or issues found during investigation.
  • Contribute to the knowledge management in the department.
  • Collaboration with the support and deployment teams to resolve issues. Good with documentation and RCA preparation.
  • Development of training material, for education and knowledge sharing with other team members as appropriate.
  • A good understanding how to monitor and improve service quality.
  • Stay on top of customer reported issues, regularly communicate with customers.

Technical Skills:

  • Excellent in problem-solving and analytical skills.
  • Good experience with at least one scripting language (bash, python, perl).
  • Experience in support and configuration of software applications on both Linux and Windows operating systems.
  • Knowledge of applications clusters for application redundancy desirable ,e.G., Red Hat Cluster.
  • Experience with operation and support of virtual machines using VMware (vSphere and vCenter) would be advantageous
  • Experience with a video delivery system, preferably in a support or integration role.
  • Solid with relational database (Oracle preferred) and non-relational database (Mongo preferred). Good understanding of networking, TCP/IP and UDP protocols
  • Good understanding of network transfer protocols HTTP, FTP.
  • Strong in automation and process improvement.
  • Experience in digital video delivering systems with in-depth knowledge in at least one of the following technologies: Conditional Access, DRM, OTT, STB, Encryption, Decryption.
  • Knowledge of MPEG/DVB or other video delivery technologies.
  • Awareness of STB software and hardware.
  • Ability to understand data represented in XML or JSON.
  • Good to have knowledge of Media products.
  • Aware of multimedia concepts in Mpeg2, H.264, TS, OTT, IPTV, HD & SD resolutions, 4K TV, DRM, VOD, Live streaming, PPV, Adaptive Streaming
  • Team handling experience would be a Plus.

Qualifications, Experience and Personal skills:

  • Bachelor’s degree/BCA/ B. Tech or equivalent.
  • Ideally 8 years of experience in a relevant support, integration, or deployment role.
  • Ability to work within a multi-tasking dynamic environment and cope with changing priorities
  • Quick learner
  • Proactive
  • Experience dealing with global customers.
  • Ability to work individually or as part of a team
  • Strong communicator at management and technical levels
  • Self-motivated and self-sufficient

When welcoming new talent into the team, we are always looking for opportunities to bring in new ideas, those who ask challenging questions and have the curiosity to learn. These qualities are important to us as we nurture a culture of innovation, seize more opportunities to partner with our customers and make a difference as we transform the future of video. To further support your growth and that of our talent pool, Synamedia offers an exhaustive library of skill enhancement resources from AWS, SkillSoft and other partners to help you upskill while on the job. Be it data analytics that piques your brain or content creation, there’s something for every kind of mind.

Benefits and Perks

  • Flexible working arrangements.
  • Competitive pay hikes and bonus packages.
  • Skill enhancement and growth opportunities.
  • Equal opportunity employment.
  • Health and wellbeing programmes.
  • Collaborative work with a truly global team.

A Culture of Belonging

Synamedia is committed to promoting a diverse, inclusive and equal opportunity community - a place where we can all be ourselves and succeed. Our values connect us, and we love to win together. We work with a bias to action, have a bold approach and encourage being deeply curious to grow and evolve, as a team.

In our aim to foster a people-friendly environment, we offer a range of family friendly, inclusive employment policies, flexible working arrangements, engagement activities and services to support all our colleagues across our 20 office locations. Synamedia regularly organises community events that promote cohesion and diversity among colleagues. We are proud of our mental health wellbeing initiatives, our Pride month awareness campaign, our cancer awareness programme and much more.

More information

If this role sparks your interest or any questions, or if you require any accommodations to be made to help you through your application, please reach out to our recruitment team, who would be happy to help.

title: Head Of Medical Marketing And Advocacy (M/F/D)
description:
Overview

Goal of function: We are seeking a Head of Medical Marketing and Advocacy (m/f/d) to lead and innovate Care Enablement advocacy strategies to improve external HCP stakeholder engagement and knowledge development, ultimately creating advocacy for innovative therapies. The position involves developing and organizing customized advocacy programs such as therapy educational round tables, symposia and reference center programs for targeted education and advocacy, creating opportunities to meaningfully educate and impact the practice of participants. It requires collaboration across all functions of the business units and regions (Marketing, Sales, Application, Compliance, and Medical Affairs) to develop an agile program strategy aligned with business priorities and strategic imperatives.


Your Responsibilities

  • Lead the creation and execution of a strategic medical marketing and advocacy plan targeting external HCPs, aligned with business goals and addressing gaps, ensuring a consistent risk-based approach. Collaborate with Medical Affairs and Commercial teams for scientific accuracy and strategic alignment

  • Collaborate with Medical Affairs to build strong relationships with internal and external speakers to create impactful educational programs. Identify, engage, and nurture key opinion leaders (KOLs), rising stars, and regional champions. Establish and support reference centers of excellence as hubs for peer-to-peer learning and clinical demonstration

  • Oversee planning, contracting, and execution of impactful advocacy activities like commercial symposia, workshops, and conferences. Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to ensure high-quality events within medical and legal compliance frameworks

  • Lead the creation of targeted therapy content of the programs and events for diverse external audiences ensuring compliance with regulations and accreditation standards. Collaborate with KOLs on timely, creative promotion using marketing and social media platforms

  • Establish a global approval matrix for activities to ensure education programs comply with regulations and standards. Monitor and implement emerging regulatory trends

  • Lead a small team, ensure budget transparency, and foster a high-performance, collaborative culture

  • Assess educational program effectiveness using data, feedback, and performance metrics to drive continuous improvement


Your Profile

  • Ideally Master’s degree in Life Sciences, Pharmacy, or Medicine. Advanced qualifications such as a PhD, Doctorate, MBA, or a marketing degree are considered a plus. Candidates with strong relevant experience may also be considered from other academic backgrounds

  • Min of 5-7 years of experience with advanced degree (alternatively min. of 10-15 years of experience with Master’s degree) in medical marketing, HCP education, or advocacy development within the pharmaceutical or biotech industry

  • Fluent in English, additional language skills (e.G., Dutch, German, Spanish) are a plus

  • Proven track record of building and managing KOL networks and educational initiatives

  • Strong understanding of regulatory and compliance frameworks in medical communications

  • Leads with vision and impact, demonstrating excellent communication, project management, and stakeholder engagement skills while navigating complexity, ensuring accountability, and driving continuous improvement to achieve strategic goals

  • Willingness to travel regionally/nationally as needed


Our Offer for you

There is a lot you can discover at Fresenius Medical Care, because we have a lot to offer. No matter on which field you are an expert (m/f/d) and how much experience you have - for your professional career.


A Future with meaning:



  • Whether in front of or behind the scenes - you are helping to make ever better medicine available to more and more people around the world

  • Individual opportunities for self-determined career planning and professional development

  • A corporate culture in which there is enough room for innovative thinking - to find the best solution together, not the quickest one

  • A large number of committed people with a wide range of skills, talents and experience

  • The benefits of a successful global corporation with the collegial culture of a medium-sized company

title: Design Director, Ui/Ux & Brand
description:
About Darkroom

Darkroom is a technology-driven growth marketing firm focused on growth-stage consumer companies. Founded in 2017, we build on a universal AI commerce layer called Matter, employing senior human resources enriched by an agentic technology stack to enhance output, efficiency, and revenue generation for our clients. Our team has delivered billions of dollars in trackable revenue across e‑commerce, direct-to-consumer, and social commerce programs, accelerating results through high‑impact digital strategies that unlock revenue growth, transform marketing operations, and prioritize profitability.

The Role

We are hiring a Design Director—a visionary leader with a strong design background, driving high‑quality design execution across various platforms and managing creative talent. You’ll combine strategic oversight with hands‑on involvement, ensuring every design project meets the highest standards of excellence.

Responsibilities
  • Lead 1–3 UI/UX engagements, focusing on branded e‑commerce websites.
  • Emphasize branded UI, conversion‑focused UX and clear design approaches.
  • Present design work to clients, explaining design choices based on effective reasoning and UX principles.
  • Manage design projects independently from discovery to hand‑off, adhering to timelines and collaborating with developers to ensure feasibility.
  • Develop component systems and maintain design guidelines for consistency.
  • Manage a team of designers, starting with 2–4 direct reports and expanding as the team grows;
    provide strategy, project management, design feedback, performance evaluation, and escalation handling.
  • Conduct weekly 1:1s with direct reports to assess client health, offer feedback and oversee career development.
  • Ensure high‑quality work output, focusing on visual craft, UX expertise and meeting deadlines.
  • Collaborate with cross‑functional teams—marketers, strategists, developers, and clients—to develop project plans, understand business objectives and address client issues.
  • Refine internal processes for client work in coordination with the Director of Creative;
    provide training and feedback to enhance the skills of the design team.
Qualifications
  • 3–6+ years of senior‑level web design experience with e‑commerce companies;
    at least 1 year of people‑management experience preferred.
  • Digital portfolio showcasing web design and branding skills—color theory, hierarchy, composition, typography.
  • Self‑motivated, proactive, detail‑oriented with strong sense of ownership.
  • Experience collaborating with developers and documenting designs for development hand‑off.
  • Comfortable with client‑facing responsibilities in English, leading discovery calls and resolving client feedback.
  • Ability to provide constructive internal feedback and guide direct reports.
  • Ability to tackle ambiguous problems, understand business challenges, design solutions and execute them effectively.
  • Proficiency in Figma (Auto Layout, Components, Variants) and Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator);
    bonus: familiarity with HTML/CSS or frameworks like Tailwind.
Remote & Compensation

Fully remote role operating in EST time zone, 100% conducted in English. Benefits include flexible parental leave, remote‑first culture, growth opportunities, autonomy with accountability, and a high‑bar performance environment.

Equal Opportunity

Darkroom is an equal‑opportunity workplace—dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national orientation, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.

title: Design Director, Ui/Ux & Brand
description:
About Darkroom

Darkroom is a technology-driven growth marketing firm focused on growth-stage consumer companies. We were founded in 2017 out of a conviction that the iconic ad agencies of tomorrow would look very different. Darkroom is a human services firm built on a universal AI commerce layer called Matter. Our model deploys a unique blend of senior, human resources enriched by an agentic technology stack that enhances output, efficiency, and revenue generation for our clients.

Our team has been responsible for billions of dollars in trackable revenue across the various e-commerce marketplace, direct-to-consumer, and social commerce programs under management. Using research aggregated across these engagements, we accelerate results for our portfolio by developing high-impact digital strategies that unlock gateways to revenue growth, transform marketing operations, and prioritize profitability.

What started as a boutique design agency evolved into one of the fastest-growing private companies in America (Inc. 5000), one of the most successful results-driven performance media agencies of the 2020s (Varos), and esteemed recognition by Forbes 30 Under 30 for our founders’ contribution in Marketing & Advertising (Forbes).

About the Role

We are hiring a Design Director - a visionary leader with a strong design background who thrives in driving high-quality design execution across various platforms as well as managing creative talent. You’ll combine strategic oversight with hands‑on involvement, ensuring that every design project meets the highest standards of excellence.

That role requires deep experience in branded UI/UX design. You’re a senior-level design lead that can independently own multiple web design engagements simultaneously. Navigating client feedback and pushback is an everyday muscle you successfully work with. You can show deep experience in being able to thread the needle between game‑changing UI, conversion‑oriented UX, and technical feasibility, all on a tight timeline. Clients are consistently impressed by your knowledge of e-commerce heuristics and how you combine that with unique and branded design. You love working with developers to understand how to make your ideas come to life and sell clients on design solutions and tradeoffs they have to make to complete engagements on‑time.

You pride yourself on being able to effortlessly spin up a new brand design system for a client that feels differentiated, elevated, and informed by your strategic market analysis. You have consistently merged business thinking with exceptional visual craft into scalable brand identities that work across paid media, retention, web, social, and packaging.

In addition to your individual contributor responsibilities, you will report to the Director of Creative and play a key role in guiding a talented team of designers, overseeing the delivery of exceptional designs for paid ads, emails, landing pages, and e-commerce web design. With your deep expertise in UI/UX and brand design, you’ll empower your team to elevate their skills while maintaining a high bar for creative output and attention to detail.

This role requires a balance of creativity, business strategy, and leadership in a fast-paced, collaborative environment. You’ll work closely with marketing, product, and development teams to ensure the alignment of design goals with broader business objectives. Your ability to drive creative strategy and manage multiple projects with precision will be essential to your success. Darkroom is a career incubator for ambitious talent looking to operate at the intersection of business, design, and innovation.

This is a fully remote role operating in the EST Time Zone and all business is conducted 100% in English.

Senior Individual Contributor Responsibilities:

  • Lead 1-3 UI/UX engagements as needed, focusing on creating branded e-commerce websites.

  • Emphasize branded UI, conversion‑focused UX, and clarity in design approaches.

  • Present design work to clients, explaining design choices based on effective reasoning and UX principles.

  • Manage design projects independently from discovery to hand‑off, adhering to timelines and collaborating with developers to ensure feasibility.

  • Develop component systems and maintain design guidelines for consistency.

Management Responsibilities:

  • Manage a team of designers, starting with 2-4 direct reports and expanding as the team grows. Provide support in strategy, project management, design feedback, performance evaluation, and handling escalations.

  • Conduct weekly 1:1s with direct reports to assess client health, offer feedback, and oversee career development.

  • Ensure high-quality work output from direct reports, focusing on visual craft, UX expertise, and meeting deadlines.

  • Collaborate with cross‑functional teams, including marketers, strategists, developers, and clients, to develop project plans, understand business objectives, and address client issues.

  • Refine internal processes for client work in coordination with the Director of Creative. Provide training and feedback to enhance the skills of the design team.

You Should Apply if this Sounds Like You:

  • 3-6+ years of senior‑level web design experience with e‑commerce companies, with at least 1 year of people management experience preferred. Must have experience in responsive web design.

  • Digital portfolio showcasing web design and branding skills, including color theory, hierarchy, composition, and typography.

  • Self‑motivated, proactive, and detail‑oriented with a strong sense of ownership.

  • Experience collaborating with developers and documenting designs for development hand‑off.

  • Comfortable with client‑facing responsibilities in English, including leading discovery calls and resolving client feedback.

  • Capable of providing constructive internal feedback and guiding direct reports to improve their work.

  • Ability to tackle ambiguous problems, understand business challenges, design solutions, and execute them effectively.

  • Proficiency in Figma, including features like Auto Layout, Components, and Variants, is essential.

  • Experience with Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator) is required.

  • Bonus: Familiarity with HTML/CSS or frameworks like Tailwind.

Working at Darkroom

Darkroom is not a typical agency. We are looking for A players that want to build something great. There is no room in our organization for mediocrity and candidates that are not at the top of their game do not last. We move fast, think deeply, and expect every team member to bring insight and rigor to everything they touch. We hold a high bar for performance, creativity, and ownership — but we also support each other relentlessly. No egos, no red tape — just world‑class talent building something remarkable.

We believe in autonomy with accountability , truth over comfort , and outcomes over optics . If you want to build and win alongside some of the smartest people in the business, you’ll thrive here.

  • Location, location, (or no) location: Remote‑first culture with a strong community base. With Hubs in the Bay Area, New York, Philly, Lisbon, Sao Paulo, and Barcelona!

  • Parental Leave: flexible parental leave benefits to support new parents during this important transition, ensuring time to bond with their families while maintaining work‑life balance.

  • Endless opportunities for growth: Our agency is founded on an interdisciplinary approach, giving Darkroomers insights into services far beyond your job description. Grow your skills and interests beyond your niche and stay at the forefront of the industry through total immersion in cross‑functional collaboration.

Equal Opportunity Statement

Darkroom is an equal opportunity workplace—we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national orientation, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.

title: Sr. Clinical Operations Lead
description:
Responsible for the clinical operations of a project within a defined regional/global level. Provides oversight of project deliverables, assigned Clinical Research Associate (CRAs) and Investigator sites in accordance with the Monitoring Plan, Protocol, Good Clinical Practice (GCP), ICH guidelines and local regulations. The COL acts as a primary liaison between the CRAs and the clinical project team. Additional responsibilities include project specific training of CRAs, conducting assessment visits with CRAs, implementation of enrollment and recruitment strategies, preparation of the monitoring plan and other structural documentation and the oversight of monitoring visit scheduling, site and monitoring performance metrics, issue escalation and corrective actions. The COL will develop study tools for site and CRA use, review visit reports, review and track protocol deviations, and support other objectives for clinical operations and the clinical project team.

Project Oversight
  • Overall oversight of (a group of) regional CRAs to ensure (site) compliance with study protocol, study plans, ICH-GCP, local regulations and study timelines.
  • Monitoring support visits (Co-monitoring), per project requirements, to aid the site/CRA in the satisfactory performance and compliance with standards mentioned above.
  • May support clinical project team by providing oversight of study deliverables related to other departments (e.G. Data Management, TMF Operations, etc.)
  • Oversee regional startup and feasibility activities.
  • Assist in vendor management activities as required per project.
  • Perform review of visit reports for quality, compliance and appropriate site management.
  • Assure compliance with high quality and timely project deliverables according to the project requirements and the monitoring plan.
  • Proactive management of site and country performance (recruitment, data collection, document collection, TMF review etc.) and inform clinical project team on progress.
  • Contribute to financial project management processes as applicable. May include but may not be limited to input on revenue recognition, site payments, and site pass-through expense review.
  • May be required to manage/oversee investigator sites including CRA responsibilities, on a temporary or permanent basis.
Project Liaison
  • Conduct regular global CRA calls with the monitoring and site management team, as well as individual/country CRA calls
  • Attend meetings with Study Sponsor to provide status updates on country and site progress
  • Provide operational support and guidance to the monitoring team throughout project.
  • Provide project training/mentoring to regional CRAs on study procedures, clinical plans and guidelines, and timelines for the study. Ensures study specific training requirements are completed and documented.
  • First point of contact for regional CRAs for study-specific questions and issues. Escalates to PM and other functions as appropriate.
  • Support line managers by providing status updates on utilization and performance of CRAs.
  • Liaise with line manager for assigning sites to CRAs following line manager allocation of a CRA resource to the project.
  • Conduct CRA Assessment visits per departmental requirements to assess the performance of the CRA against their monitoring responsibilities.
Study Documents and Plans
  • Develop training materials and study tools for sites and CRAs, including monitoring plans.
  • Develop and implement enrolment and recruitment strategies together with clinical project team.
  • Develop presentation materials for and presents at Sponsor Kickoff meetings, Investigator meetings and Sponsor Calls (as needed), and prepares presentations for Site Qualification Visits and Site Initiation Visits.
Qualifications
  • College diploma/degree AND 7-9 years related experience +continuous training and knowledge/skills upgrading
  • OR Undergraduate university degree (Bachelors or Honors Bachelors) AND 4-6 years\ ' experience + substantial on-going job-related training
Other
  • Health Sciences, Life Sciences or Nursing specialty preferred, or SoCRA and/or ACRP Certification/Designation.
  • Should have a minimum of 3 years CRA experience, have strong experience with EDC systems, be proficient with MS Office, have strong written and verbal communication skills and highly effective interpersonal and organizational skills.
  • Demonstrate the following attributes: proactive, detail oriented, task-driven and highly organized.
  • Demonstrate the critical elements of GCPs and local regulations as they relate to clinical monitoring, IRB/EC and Investigator responsibilities.
  • Demonstrated ability in report writing and strong ability to critically understand clinical research documents.
  • Ability to handle multiple tasks to meet deadlines in a dynamic environment.
Working Conditions

  • Experiência em documentação de APIs usando o padrão OpenAPI ou similares como Swagger, gerados automaticamente através do código da aplicação desenvolvida. É esperado que também consiga elaborar manualmente contratos de APIs usando OpenAPI.
  • Familiaridade com o desenvolvimento de aplicações web, utilizando tecnologias como HTML, CSS e JavaScript.
  • Proatividade na automação de tarefas e otimização de entregas, utilizando scripts, extensões, plugins de IDE e IA de forma responsável .
  • Experiência com bancos de dados relacionais (MySQL, PostgreSQL, Oracle, SQL Server), modelagem de dados, SQL e ORMs como Hibernate.
  • Expertise em práticas e convenções para desenvolvimento de software como SOLID, design patterns, clean code e outras que valorizam melhores práticas.
  • Domínio em versionamento de código usando GIT, bem como resolução de conflitos em merges de branchs.
  • Experiência com a integração de APIs REST e serviços de terceiros, aplicando melhores práticas na elaboração de contratos de comunicação.
  • Experiência com soluções de mensageria (como AWS SQS, RabbitMQ ou similar) ou baseada em eventos (como Kafka, Azure Service Bus, GCP PubSub, AWS SNS ou similares).
  • Experiência com computação em nuvem, incluindo pelo menos um dos principais provedores: AWS (Lambda, S3, SQS, EC2, RDS), Azure (Functions, Blob Storage, Service Bus) ou GCP (Cloud Functions, Pub/Sub, Firestore).


Você irá se destacar e será considerado diferencial se:

  • Experiência com observabilidade (DataDog, NewRelic, Dynatrace) e implementação de dashboards.
  • Implementação de telemetria com OpenTelemetry.
  • Conhecimento em estratégias de resiliência com Resilient4J ou similares.
  • Experiência com gRPC e SSE (Server-Sent Events).
  • Conhecimento em arquitetura hexagonal.
  • Experiência com ferramentas de mock para APIs REST.

  • Programa de Pontos Flexíveis em seu Caju - um valor fléxivel para você usar como você quiser;
  • Plano de Saúde Nacional Porto Seguro (Plano Prata com apartamento e sem coparticipação) com 50% da mensalidade custeada pela Builders;
  • Assistência Odontológica pela Porto Seguro (Plano Bronze) com 100% da mensalidade paga pela Builders;
  • Auxílio Creche para crianças de até 72 meses;
  • Auxílio à SaúdeMental - acesso ao aplicativo Vida+ ;
  • Auxílio à SaúdeFísica - acesso ao aplicativo Gympass ;
  • Seguro de vida.

title: Analista De Contratos Sênior
description:
Analista de Contratos Sênior

Join to apply for the Analista de Contratos Sênior role at NTS - Nova Transportadora do Sudeste

A NTS (Nova Transportadora do Sudeste S/A – NTS) transporta gás natural por meio de um sólido sistema de gasodutos, conectando a região mais industrializada do Brasil com segurança e confiabilidade. São mais de 2.000 quilômetros de gasodutos ligando os estados do Rio de Janeiro, Minas Gerais e São Paulo ao gasoduto Bolívia‑Brasil, aos terminais de GNL e às plantas de processamento de gás.

Nossos Valores
  • Respeito à vida e ao meio ambiente: Nosso compromisso é com a segurança dos nossos funcionários e das comunidades e com a preservação do meio ambiente por onde passamos.
  • Integridade: Atuamos com transparência e comprometimento em todas nossas relações, nos pautando pela legalidade.
  • Foco em resultado: Não nos encantamos com sofisticações desnecessárias. Concentramos nossos esforços no alcance das metas e no foco em resultados.
  • Postura de dono: Olhar além do resultado imediato e tomar a melhor decisão para a empresa é uma atitude de todos os nossos funcionários.
Descrição da Vaga

Estamos em busca de um(a) Analista de Contratos para atuar na gestão contratual da Gerência de Engenharia e Gasodutos. Essa posição será responsável por acompanhar o ciclo completo dos contratos, desde a elaboração e controle de requisições até o acompanhamento de execução, medição, faturamento e encerramento, garantindo conformidade técnica, financeira e regulatória.

Responsabilidades
  • Gerenciar contratos da Gerência de Engenharia e Gasodutos, controlando saldos, prazos, cronogramas, escopos, desembolsos, aditivos, multas e cláusulas contratuais.
  • Elaborar e acompanhar Requisições de Compra (RCs) de serviços e materiais.
  • Revisar documentos técnicos como Memorial Descritivo (MD) e Planilha de Preços Unitários (PPU).
  • Acompanhar processos de compra junto à área de Suprimentos, assegurando fluxo de aprovações e avaliação técnica dos proponentes.
  • Conduzir reuniões de Kick-off (KOM) com contratadas.
  • Elaborar relatórios e dashboards de consumo contratual, prazos e status.
  • Realizar boletins de medição, consolidar evidências, controlar assinaturas, emitir SES e acompanhar faturamento e pagamento.
  • Atuar como interface técnica, jurídica e administrativa entre bases operacionais e áreas corporativas.
  • Realizar reuniões de acompanhamento contratual com fornecedores.
  • Garantir aderência orçamentária dos contratos sob sua responsabilidade.
  • Assegurar conformidade das contratadas às políticas de segurança e compliance da companhia.
Requisitos
  • Ensino superior completo em Administração, Engenharia de Produção, Comércio Exterior ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência prévia com gestão de contratos, compras e materiais, preferencialmente nos setores de óleo e gás ou infraestrutura.
  • Conhecimento em SAP ou sistemas similares de gestão de compras e contratos.
  • Excel avançado.
  • Boa comunicação, organização e capacidade de atuar com múltiplas interfaces.
  • Vivência com contratos de alta complexidade e gestão orçamentária.
  • Prontidão para resolução de problemas e tomada de decisão.
Diferencial
  • Conhecimento em Power BI e ferramentas de análise de dados.
  • Experiência com políticas de compliance e segurança aplicadas à gestão contratual.
Oferecemos
  • Ambiente de trabalho dinâmico e colaborativo.
  • Oportunidade de desenvolvimento e aprendizado contínuo.
  • Bolsa‑auxílio e benefícios compatíveis com o mercado: Cartão flexível Alimentação/Refeição, Plano de Saúde Bradesco Nacional e Odontológico Privian Master, Seguro de vida, Previdência Privada, Total Pass, Auxílio‑medicamentos pelo Vidalink, Vale‑presente, Vale‑transporte, Ticket de Natal, Auxílio creche/babá e PLR.
Como se preparar para o processo seletivo
  • Pesquise sobre a NTS: Entenda a história, valores e missão da NTS. Visite o site oficial e leia notícias recentes.
  • Revisão de CV: Garanta que seu currículo esteja atualizado e reflita suas habilidades e experiências relevantes.
  • Prepare‑se para perguntas: Pense em exemplos concretos de situações em que demonstrou suas habilidades e competências.
  • Conheça a vaga: Entenda as responsabilidades e requisitos da posição para alinhar suas respostas às expectativas da empresa.
Etapas do Processo Seletivo
  • Entrevista com time de Gente: Para discutir mais sobre a empresa, aderência à vaga e expectativas.
  • Entrevista com o Gestor: Para conversar sobre aspectos do dia a dia, conhecimento técnico e carreira.
  • Entrevista com as Interfaces: Coordenadores e clientes internos que terão contato próximo com a área.
  • Entrevista com os Coordenadores ou Gerentes da área: Última etapa para conhecer a liderança e alinhar expectativas finais.
Por que trabalhar conosco?

Na NTS, você encontra um ambiente dinâmico, inclusivo e acolhedor, onde as pessoas são valorizadas e têm espaço para crescer. Acreditamos no poder da diversidade, da colaboração e do desenvolvimento contínuo.

Oferecemos oportunidades reais de aprendizado e evolução profissional, com programas estruturados e incentivo ao protagonismo de carreira.

Nosso pacote de benefícios é completo e pensado para cuidar de você em todas as fases da vida:

  • Plano de saúde de qualidade.
  • Previdência privada.
  • Vale refeição/alimentação (Swile).
  • Auxílio farmácia.
  • Auxílio creche.
  • Day‑off de aniversário.
  • TotalPass.
  • Participação nos Lucros e Resultados (PLR).

title: Pessoa Analista Administrativo Sênior - Gestão De Contratos
description:
Job description

Nascemos em 2017 com o propósito de Ser a Melhor Empresa de Saneamento PARA o Brasil. Hoje, estamos presentes em diversos municípios e estados brasileiros, com o objetivo de contribuir para que o país alcance a universalização dos serviços de água e esgoto.

Nosso modelo de negócios consiste em concessões e parcerias público-privadas (PPPs). Somos uma das principais companhias de saneamento do país, inserida na vida de comunidades de diferentes portes e atendendo milhões de pessoas.

Inovação, sustentabilidade, geração de valor e foco na satisfação do cliente fazem parte da nossa cultura organizacional. Venha fazer parte dessa transformação com a gente!

Local de Atuação: Rio de Janeiro, RJ (Iguá Rio de Janeiro S.A).

Main responsibilities
  • Elaborar e emitir relatórios e realizar atividades administrativas diversas de alta complexidade, relacionados a rotina administrativa da área de acordo com a solicitação e orientação recebida;
  • Receber, analisar e controlar a documentação para abertura de RC’s de contratos no sistema SAP, acompanhando o processo até a entrega do instrumento contratual, através da interface com as áreas operacionais, Suprimentos e Jurídico.
  • Controlar e acompanhar a carteira de contratos, monitorando prazos de pagamento, vigência, multas, SLA, garantindo a aplicabilidade das cláusulas pactuadas sejam cumpridas.
  • Responsável pela abertura de chamados de termos de quitação e encerramentos dos contratos finalizados;
  • Preencher os controles e indicadores da área;
  • Receber informações para elaboração de KPIs da operação, questionando e entendendo os dados apresentados, assegurando o correto reporte e propondo ações para melhoria dos indicadores;
  • Participar das reuniões de kickoff juntamente com as áreas de negócio e fornecedores;
  • Criar requisição de medição no sistema SAP, boletim de medição, folha de registro e autorizar emissão de nota fiscal para o fornecedor;
  • Conferir os boletins de medição aprovados pelas áreas de negócio, a fim de averiguar se cabem multas ou glosas referentes ao período de medição;
  • Acompanhar as tratativas tributarias com o fornecedor, por meio de interface com as áreas Contábeis e Controladoria;
  • Supervisionar aentrega de documentos obrigatórios inerentes às contratações, garantindo que os termos do contrato sejam cumpridos;
  • Emitir notificações Extrajudiciais por meio de abertura de chamado junto ao Jurídico para fornecedores com pendências documentais, ou por descumprimento de cronograma ou quebras de regras de SST;
  • Acompanhar os chamados emitidos para a área de gestão de contratos no sistema Service Now, garantindo o cumprimento dos SLA’s da área;
  • Seguir os procedimentos e normas da área de gestão de contratos, garantindo a correta aplicabilidade nos processos relacionados;
  • Seguir as normas internas relacionadas as áreas de qualidade, meio ambiente, compliance, saúde e segurança do trabalho, dentre outras, em da melhoria contínua.
Requirements and skills

Requisitos e Qualificações:

  • Graduação Completa em Administração, Contabilidade, Financeiro, Direito, Engenharias ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência em trabalhar com o SAP no módulo MM;
  • Domínio no Pacote Office, em especial o Excel;
  • Experiência comgestão de contratos.

Requisitos desejáveis:

  • Conhecimento no Servicenow;
  • Experiência em trabalhar com Power BI;
  • CNH categoria B;
  • Inglês.

Domínio do pacote Office;
Perfil colaborativo e organizado. Na Iguá Saneamento valorizamos a diferença em todos os contextos e trabalhamos para promover uma cultura ética e inclusiva sempre. Como companhia e time, buscamos a equidade e respeitamos todos os tipos de diversidade (Gênero, Deficiência - PCD, LGBTQIAPN+, Étnico racial, Crenças e Gerações). Venha fazer parte dessa mudança, acreditamos na força de cada individualidade para gerar transformação!

Additional information✨ Nossos BenefíciosAqui, cuidamos das nossas pessoas em todas as etapas da sua jornada como colaborador. Conheça o que oferecemos:

title: Design Director, Ui/Ux & Brand
description:
Darkroom is a technology-driven growth marketing firm focused on growth-stage consumer companies. We were founded in 2017 out of a conviction that the iconic ad agencies of tomorrow would look very different. Darkroom is a human services firm built on a universal AI commerce layer called Matter. Our model deploys a unique blend of senior, human resources enriched by an agentic technology stack that enhances output, efficiency, and revenue generation for our clients.

Our team has been responsible for billions of dollars in trackable revenue across the various e-commerce marketplace, direct-to-consumer, and social commerce programs under management. Using research aggregated across these engagements, we accelerate results for our portfolio by developing high-impact digital strategies that unlock gateways to revenue growth, transform marketing operations, and prioritize profitability.

What started as a boutique design agency evolved into one of the fastest-growing private companies in America (Inc. 5000), one of the most successful results-driven performance media agencies of the 2020s (Varos), and esteemed recognition by Forbes 30 Under 30 for our founders’ contribution in Marketing & Advertising (Forbes).

About the Role

We are hiring a Design Director - a visionary leader with a strong design background who thrives in driving high-quality design execution across various platforms as well as managing creative talent. You’ll combine strategic oversight with hands‑on involvement, ensuring that every design project meets the highest standards of excellence.

That role requires deep experience in branded UI/UX design. You’re a senior-level design lead that can independently own multiple web design engagements simultaneously. Navigating client feedback and pushback is an everyday muscle you successfully work with. You can show deep experience in being able to thread the needle between game‑changing UI, conversion‑oriented UX, and technical feasibility, all on a tight timeline. Clients are consistently impressed by your knowledge of e-commerce heuristics and how you combine that with unique and branded design. You love working with developers to understand how to make your ideas come to life and sell clients on design solutions and tradeoffs they have to make to complete engagements on‑time.

You pride yourself on being able to effortlessly spin up a new brand design system for a client that feels differentiated, elevated, and informed by your strategic market analysis. You have consistently merged business thinking with exceptional visual craft into scalable brand identities that work across paid media, retention, web, social, and packaging.

In addition to your individual contributor responsibilities, you will report to the Director of Creative and play a key role in guiding a talented team of designers, overseeing the delivery of exceptional designs for paid ads, emails, landing pages, and e-commerce web design. With your deep expertise in UI/UX and brand design, you’ll empower your team to elevate their skills while maintaining a high bar for creative output and attention to detail.

This role requires a balance of creativity, business strategy, and leadership in a fast-paced, collaborative environment. You’ll work closely with marketing, product, and development teams to ensure the alignment of design goals with broader business objectives. Your ability to drive creative strategy and manage multiple projects with precision will be essential to your success. Darkroom is a career incubator for ambitious talent looking to operate at the intersection of business, design, and innovation.

This is a fully remote role operating in the EST Time Zone and all business is conducted 100% in English.

Lead 1-3 UI/UX engagements as needed, focusing on creating branded e-commerce websites.

Emphasize branded UI, conversion‑focused UX, and clarity in design approaches.

Present design work to clients, explaining design choices based on effective reasoning and UX principles.

Manage design projects independently from discovery to hand‑off, adhering to timelines and collaborating with developers to ensure feasibility.

Develop component systems and maintain design guidelines for consistency.

Management Responsibilities:

Manage a team of designers, starting with 2-4 direct reports and expanding as the team grows. Provide support in strategy, project management, design feedback, performance evaluation, and handling escalations.

Conduct weekly 1:1s with direct reports to assess client health, offer feedback, and oversee career development.

Ensure high-quality work output from direct reports, focusing on visual craft, UX expertise, and meeting deadlines.

Collaborate with cross‑functional teams, including marketers, strategists, developers, and clients, to develop project plans, understand business objectives, and address client issues.

Refine internal processes for client work in coordination with the Director of Creative. Provide training and feedback to enhance the skills of the design team.

You Should Apply if this Sounds Like You:

3-6+ years of senior‑level web design experience with e‑commerce companies, with at least 1 year of people management experience preferred. Must have experience in responsive web design.

Digital portfolio showcasing web design and branding skills, including color theory, hierarchy, composition, and typography.

Self‑motivated, proactive, and detail‑oriented with a strong sense of ownership.

Experience collaborating with developers and documenting designs for development hand‑off.

Comfortable with client‑facing responsibilities in English, including leading discovery calls and resolving client feedback.

Capable of providing constructive internal feedback and guiding direct reports to improve their work.

Ability to tackle ambiguous problems, understand business challenges, design solutions, and execute them effectively.

Proficiency in Figma, including features like Auto Layout, Components, and Variants, is essential.

Experience with Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator) is required.

Bonus: Familiarity with HTML/CSS or frameworks like Tailwind.

Working at Darkroom

Darkroom is not a typical agency. We are looking for A players that want to build something great. There is no room in our organization for mediocrity and candidates that are not at the top of their game do not last. We move fast, think deeply, and expect every team member to bring insight and rigor to everything they touch. We hold a high bar for performance, creativity, and ownership — but we also support each other relentlessly. No egos, no red tape — just world‑class talent building something remarkable.

We believe in autonomy with accountability , truth over comfort , and outcomes over optics . If you want to build and win alongside some of the smartest people in the business, you’ll thrive here.

Location, location, (or no) location: Remote‑first culture with a strong community base. With Hubs in the Bay Area, New York, Philly, Lisbon, SaoPaulo, and Barcelona!

Parental Leave: flexible parental leave benefits to support new parents during this important transition, ensuring time to bond with their families while maintaining work‑life balance.

Endless opportunities for growth: Our agency is founded on an interdisciplinary approach, giving Darkroomers insights into services far beyond your job description. Grow your skills and interests beyond your niche and stay at the forefront of the industry through total immersion in cross‑functional collaboration.

Equal Opportunity Statement

Darkroom is an equal opportunity workplace—we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national orientation, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.

description:
O CENTRO DO OLHO CARIOCA está localizado na região central da cidade, no Bairro de Benfica. Os serviços prestados abrangem toda a população carioca, residente da cidade. É uma unidade especializada com vistas à promoção da saúde e prevenção de doenças e acidentes, além de identificar possíveis alterações relacionadas ou não com a atividade laboral e acadêmica, bem como possibilita a prevenção e a identificação precoce de eventuais patologias e riscos em potencial para a saúde visual e qualidade de vida.

A unidade de saúde é preparada para o atendimento às mais diversas patologias do universo oftalmológico para a população da cidade do Rio de Janeiro, tais como:

  • diagnóstico e tratamento dos distúrbios da motilidade ocular, visão binocular e anomalias associadas;
  • realização de exames para correção refrativa e adaptação de lentes de contacto, bem como para análise da função visual;
  • avaliação da condução nervosa do estímulo visual e das deficiências do campo visual;
  • programação e utilização de terapêuticas específicas de recuperação e reeducação das perturbações da visão binocular e de subvisão;
  • ações de sensibilização, programas de rastreio e prevenção no âmbito da promoção e educação para a saúde.
  • realização de exames oftalmológicos diagnósticos, corretivos e periódicos com o objetivo, prioritariamente, a preservação da saúde, em função dos riscos existentes das patologias de base como hipertensão arterial sistêmica, diabetes mellitus, assim como oriundas do ambiente de trabalho e educação.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Realizar leitura e interpretação da prescrição médica (receitas); Atendimento técnico (auxiliar paciente na escolha dos óculos); Confeccionar ajuste e adaptação de armações; Prestar ao paciente assistência técnica; Elaborar laudos técnicos.

A SPDM - Associação Paulista para o Desenvolvimento da Medicina é uma Associação civil sem fins lucrativos, de natureza filantrópica, reconhecida de utilidade pública federal, estadual e no município de sua sede, respectivamente pelos decretos nos , de 04/03/1966, de 17/05/1962 e 8.911, de 30/07/1970.

A Instituição atua nos âmbitos federal, estadual e municipal, em harmonia com suas políticas de saúde e de educação, e também como organização social habilitada em vários estados, na gerência de serviços e organizações de saúde, por meio de convênios e contratos de gestão.

A diretriz primordial da Associação é sua inserção no sistema de saúde direcionada ao tratamento, prevenção de doenças e à promoção da saúde primária, secundária e terciária, estreitando laços com a comunidade local e reafirmando seu compromisso social de atender a todos, sem discriminação.

Com o crescimento Institucional, a SPDM vem expandindo sua área de atuação com projetos, em desenvolvimento, na área da Assistência Social e na área Educacional. Toda essa gama de atividades consolida, cada vez mais, a SPDM como uma instituição filantrópica de grande porte, que busca a sustentabilidade econômica, social e ambiental.

Suas quatro superintendências - Hospital São Paulo, Instituições Afiliadas, Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde (PAIS) e Educação - são gerenciadas por profissionais de alta capacitação técnica e notável saber.

Assim, a SPDM contribui de forma efetiva para a melhoria contínua dos serviços prestados pelo Sistema Único de Saúde do Brasil, visando principalmente garantir a universalidade e as oportunidades de acesso à saúde, necessárias ao desenvolvimento humano e social do cidadão. Para tanto, associa o melhor da tecnologia com atendimento médico de alta qualidade, respaldado por equipes multiprofissionais, formadas por enfermeiros, fisioterapeutas, farmacêuticos, nutricionistas, fonoaudiólogos, bioquímicos, psicólogos, tecnólogos, assistentes sociais e dentistas, entre outros.

O Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde iniciou suas atividades no ano de 2001 no município de São Paulo, se estendendo para outros municípios e estados. Desde o início de suas atividades, o PAIS busca, em parceria com a gestão pública, o crescimento e a consolidação dos serviços de saúde ofertados aos usuários do SUS.

O Programa tem como objetivo garantir mudanças nos indicadores e na qualidade de vida da população, pautado, entre outros, pelos princípios da integralidade e da equidade, com uma visão estratégica da gestão dos serviços de saúde, definida em um processo de aprimoramento contínuo.

Inclusão


A SPDM oferece oportunidades de trabalho em suas unidades hospitalares, com plano de carreira, para pessoas com deficiência. Para tanto, periodicamente publica anúncio recrutando esses profissionais, nos principais jornais de São Paulo e dos municípios em que se localizam suas unidades.

Missão

Promover ações em saúde integradas com a gestão pública, em benefício da população de forma ética e humanizada, qualidade técnica, com compromisso social e ambiental.

Visão

Ser referência em gestão de serviços em saúde, abrangendo todos os níveis da assistência, garantindo atendimento com qualidade à população dos municípios e estados parceiros.

Valores

  • Profissionalismo
  • Qualidade
  • Responsabilidade Social
  • Trabalho em equipe
  • Ética

SMETA (4 Pilares)
e à implementação e acompanhamento do
SGI para ISOs 9001, 14001 e 45001
.

Trata-se de uma vaga temporária, com duração prevista de
6 meses
, período no qual a pessoa contratada terá papel central na preparação, execução e acompanhamento das conformidades internas e externas.

Responsabilidades

  • Supervisionar e preparar a empresa para auditorias sociais, ambientais e de gestão (SMETA 4 Pilares e ISOs 9001, 14001 e 45001);
  • Coordenar a implementação, acompanhamento e manutenção do Sistema de Gestão Integrado (SGI);
  • Garantir a disponibilidade, atualização e organização de todos os documentos legais, técnicos e operacionais exigidos em auditorias;
  • Acompanhar pessoalmente auditorias e reuniões de abertura e fechamento, representando a empresa de forma técnica e estratégica;
  • Coordenar e revisar Planos de Ação Corretiva (CAP) em conjunto com áreas responsáveis, monitorando prazos e eficácia das ações;
  • Articular com Gente e Gestão, Saúde e Segurança, Produção e Operações para assegurar a aderência integral às normas;
  • Contribuir em Comitês e fóruns internos, propondo melhorias contínuas voltadas à conformidade e boas práticas;
  • Apoiar iniciativas de compliance junto a fornecedores, exigindo declarações e evidências quando necessário;
  • Promover treinamentos e ações de sensibilização, reforçando a cultura de compliance e sustentabilidade.

Requisitos

  • Formação superior completa (Administração, Engenharia de Produção, Engenharia Ambiental ou áreas correlatas);
  • Experiência comprovada em auditorias
    SMETA
    e/ou
    ISOs (9001, 14001, 45001)
    ;
  • Conhecimento prático de legislações trabalhistas, ambientais e de saúde e segurança do trabalho no Brasil;
  • Capacidade de leitura, análise crítica e elaboração de documentos técnicos;
  • Organização, senso crítico, atenção aos detalhes e excelente comunicação;
  • Alinhamento com os valores e a cultura da Traços.

Diferenciais

  • Certificação em Auditoria Interna (ISO, SMETA, Compliance ou Sustentabilidade);
  • Vivência com softwares de gestão documental e ERP;
  • Experiência prévia em processos de certificação (FSC, ISOs, GOTS, LWG, entre outros).

Sobre a Traços

Fundada em 2012, a
Traços
é uma empresa multisserviços que une design e engenharia de produção. Atuamos como plataforma
one stop shop
em soluções personalizadas para o ponto de venda, com foco nos segmentos de
moda, selfcare e mercado de luxo
. Nosso portfólio inclui marcas como
L'Oréal, LVMH, Chanel, Coty, Clube Melissa e Reserva
, sempre entregando experiências com inovação, encantamento e qualidade.

Acreditamos na força da colaboração e diversidade. Nosso modelo valoriza equipes multidisciplinares, autonomia profissional e desenvolvimento contínuo. Nossa cultura se sustenta nos arquétipos do
Criador
e do
Sábio
, unindo criatividade e rigor técnico para transformar ideias em experiências marcantes.

title: professor de matemática aplicada do fundamental 2
description:
Descrição
O professor de Matemática Aplicada no Fundamental II será responsável por lecionar conteúdos matemáticos com foco em aplicações práticas e contextualizadas, ajudando os alunos a compreenderem como a matemática se conecta ao dia a dia, à tecnologia e a diferentes áreas do conhecimento. Esse profissional terá a missão de desenvolver o raciocínio lógico, o pensamento crítico e a resolução de problemas, utilizando metodologias ativas e recursos variados para tornar as aulas mais dinâmicas e significativas.

  • Experiência prévia em sala de aula, preferencialmente no Fundamental II;
  • Desejável experiência em ensino de Matemática Aplicada e metodologias ativas;
  • Habilidade para contextualizar os conteúdos em situações práticas e interdisciplinares;

  • Conhecimento em tecnologias educacionais será considerado diferencial;
  • Boa comunicação, empatia e habilidade de lidar com diferentes perfis de alunos.

title: gerente de turno
description:
Estamos em busca de um profissional dinâmico e experiente para assumir o cargo de Gerente de Turno no BREWTECO.
Como Gerente de Turno, você será responsável por liderar a equipe durante o seu turno, garantir a qualidade do serviço e o atendimento ao cliente, além de supervisionar as operações diárias para garantir a eficiência e o cumprimento das metas estabelecidas.
Você deve ter uma formação sólida em administração, hotelaria ou área relacionada, com experiência comprovada em gestão de equipes e operações de restaurantes ou similares.
Sua capacidade de liderança, habilidades de comunicação e orientação para resultados são fundamentais para o sucesso nesta posição.
Entre as principais responsabilidades, você irá gerenciar o fluxo de clientes, coordenar as atividades da equipe, garantir a manutenção dos padrões de qualidade e sanidade, além de gerenciar o estoque e controlar os custos operacionais.
Será necessário demonstrar habilidades de resolução de problemas, capacidade de tomar decisões rápidas e efetividade em gerenciar conflitos.
O BREWTECO oferece um ambiente de trabalho desafiador e gratificante, com oportunidades de crescimento profissional e desenvolvimento de carreira.
Se você está pronto para assumir um papel de liderança e fazer a diferença em um ambiente dinâmico, esta é a oportunidade perfeita para você.
